acceptance_criteria: Scope test result stated explicitly with reasoning

result.summary:
SCOPE: IN SCOPE. Diff touches lib/letflow/engine.ex (start_instance/5 composition, persist/10, complete-task hop chain, snapshot call sites) and lib/letflow/engine/reconstruction.ex (replay widened for SUB_PROCESS_COMPLETED + snapshot-aware replay source) -- both read/write tenant-scoped tables (instance_projections, tokens, tasks, events/events_archive, instance_state_snapshots) and the new parent_pins/2 is a lookup-by-(caller-supplied)-ID path. No migrations are new to this merge diff itself (priv/repo/migrations/20260819045553_add_sub_process_parent_columns.exs and .../20260821000001_create_instance_state_snapshots.exs both predate the merge and were each already gated on their own branch/PR -- confirmed via `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat -- priv/repo/migrations/` showing these as the only 2 migration files in the branch delta, both authored before commit 876e0d9).

INV-1 (tenant data isolation) -- APPLIES, PASS. This is the central question of the re-gate: parent_pins/2 (engine.ex, new in this merge, ~line 209) does `case Map.get(attrs, :parent_instance_id) do nil -> {:ok, nil}; parent_instance_id -> PinResolver.reconstruct_effective_pins(parent_instance_id, prefix: prefix) end` -- prefix is create/2's own top-level, already-validated tenant schema (Keyword.get(opts, :prefix), validated earlier via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 in the call chain the same way it always has been; unchanged by this merge), NOT a value derived from or paired with the caller-supplied parent_instance_id. Traced PinResolver.reconstruct_effective_pins/2 (lib/letflow/engine/pin_resolver.ex:499-514): its only I/O is `Reconstruction.read_full_log(instance_id, prefix, 1)`, and read_full_log (reconstruction.ex, widened to arity-3 by this same merge) queries both Event and ArchivedEvent with `where([e], e.instance_id == ^instance_id) |> Repo.all(prefix: prefix)` -- i.e. every query is scoped through Ecto's `:prefix` (schema-per-tenant, decision 0003 Dimension B) using the CALLER's resolved tenant schema, never a schema derived from the supplied instance_id. Consequence: a forged or genuinely cross-tenant parent_instance_id cannot leak another tenant's pin/event data -- querying it against the wrong tenant's Postgres schema returns zero rows (that tenant's events/events_archive tables, in that tenant's own schema, are structurally unreachable from this prefix), so reconstruct_effective_pins/2 hits its own `{:ok, []} -> {:error, :instance_not_found}` clause, which parent_pins/2 maps to `{:error, {:parent_pin_lookup_failed, :instance_not_found}}`, and create/2's `with` chain aborts before create_snapshot/3's first write -- confirmed by reading the full `with` chain in start_instance/5 (engine.ex ~line 91-112): parent_pins/2 runs strictly before create_snapshot/3. This satisfies (a) prefix-scoped query and, by construction, closes the cross-tenant-leak question the task specifically raised: the new interaction is a clean same-tenant-only failure path, not a leak. Also checked fetch_child_parent_node_id/2 (reconstruction.ex, new SUB_PROCESS_COMPLETED replay clause) -- queries the completing child's own INSTANCE_STARTED event via the same `Repo.all(prefix: prefix)` pattern using the PARENT's resolved prefix; since a child instance is always created inside its parent's own tenant schema (SubProcess.append_start_multi/7, unchanged by this merge, already gated in step-02c), this is same-tenant by construction, not a new leak surface. (b)/(c): no migration is new to this diff, so not re-derived here (see scope note above) -- both were already confirmed prefix()-guarded in their own prior gates.
INV-2 -- NOT-APPLICABLE (no multi-tenant HTTP API response surface touched; S4 not started).
INV-3 -- NOT-APPLICABLE (no Lua/WASM scripting; S5 not started).
INV-4 (secrets by reference) -- APPLIES, PASS. `grep -n "System.get_env"` and the hardcoded-secret heuristic grep run against the merge diff's two files (engine.ex, reconstruction.ex) returned zero hits either direction -- no secret material introduced, logged, or serialised by the merge (the new Logger.warning/Logger.warning calls in maybe_snapshot_after_create/4, maybe_snapshot_after_complete_task/2, maybe_snapshot_after_set_instance_error/3 log only `instance_id`, `sequence_number`, and `inspect(reason)` of a typed error tuple -- no secret-shaped field reachable).
INV-5 -- NOT-APPLICABLE (parent_pins/2 and the SubProcess paths are internal engine functions, not an HTTP lookup-by-ID endpoint; S4 not started). Noted for the record: the observable behavior (clean {:error, :instance_not_found} for both 'never existed' and 'exists, other tenant' cases, verified above under INV-1) already happens to be indistinguishable, which is the right shape for when S4 does add an HTTP surface over this, but this is not itself an INV-5 finding today.
INV-6 (new data-access paths prove scoping) -- APPLIES, PASS. This handoff is the proof artifact for the merge's one genuinely new data-access path (parent_pins/2's cross-branch interaction).
INV-7 (no raw SQL) -- APPLIES, PASS. `grep -rn "Repo.query" lib/letflow/engine.ex lib/letflow/engine/reconstruction.ex lib/letflow/engine/sub_process.ex lib/letflow/engine/pin_resolver.ex` returns zero hits. Every query in the merge diff goes through Ecto.Query/Repo.all/Repo.transaction/Ecto.Multi.
INV-8 (no unhandled crashes) -- APPLIES, PASS. `grep -n "^\s*{:ok, .*} = "` against the two diff files returns only function-head/case-clause patterns (`{:ok, %{...}} = result,` as a function parameter pattern with a fallback clause immediately below it, e.g. maybe_snapshot_after_create/4, maybe_snapshot_after_set_instance_error/3 -- each has a matching catch-all clause `defp maybe_snapshot_after_create(result, ...), do: result` immediately after), not bare destructuring assignments that raise on mismatch -- manually confirmed by reading each hit in context. parent_pins/2 itself returns a typed {:ok, _} | {:error, {:parent_pin_lookup_failed, reason}} tuple consumed by the `with` chain, no raise path. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` ran clean (no warnings) against commit 876e0d9. Test evidence (ELIXIR-DEV-reported, not independently re-run by this gate): MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test, 1105 tests, 0 failures.

No tenant-scoping guard present in either pre-merge branch was dropped: prefix is threaded unchanged through every new/changed function signature in both diffs (pin_lookup/2, parent_pins/2, prepare_sub_process_children/5, build_sub_process_children_multi/6, snapshot_instance/4, select_replay_source/2, read_full_log/3, fetch_child_parent_node_id/2) -- confirmed by reading every call site in the two diffs; none introduces a second, independently-derived prefix or drops the parameter.
